decisions.reason: The suggesting-mode deletion workflow does not change the separate requirement that the revised question list be approved before preparation of the selected-question manuscript.
The source change specifies how recommended deletions are recorded in the Google Doc; it does not change the question-review coverage, removal criteria, or curation objective.
The tracked deletion workflow is independent of how the global perspective is integrated into the manuscript.
Question deletion in suggesting mode does not alter the companion-resource package or its asset-delivery expectations.
The deletion-comment workflow does not change the required or conditional answer layers for retained questions.
The tracked editing instructions for existing-question deletions do not change the AI chapter's topic, coverage, inclusion, or length guidance.
The source workflow change does not alter the planned chapter about questions candidates can ask interviewers.
The source workflow change does not alter the first-time leader questions chapter.
The word-budget state already accounts for possible additional capacity from removed content; specifying how deletions are tracked does not change that budget.
The existing-question deletion workflow does not change the pre-interview preparation chapter's format, audience, focus, or length guidance.
The tracked editing instructions do not change the remote and hybrid leadership chapter.
The method for documenting question deletions does not alter the guide's purpose, format, target readers, or principal audience markets.
